items.claim: Ian Garry's fighting style is balanced, utilizing the outside, range, reach, and lateral movement with sprawl-and-brawl tactics.
items.quote: Balanced, stay on the outside, use the range, use his reach, pull you in and out, lateral movement, stop the wrestling, sprawl and brawl basically like a Chuck Liddell

items.claim: Ian Garry has become a little bit more aggressive in his fights than he was in the past.
items.quote: Ian Garry is he is a little bit more aggressive than he was in the past.

items.claim: Ian Garry successfully defended against Belal Muhammad's wrestling attempts by using overhooks, underhooks, and dancing off the fence.
items.quote: Belal tried to wrestle decidedly in the fight... and he said, 'No, sir. No, sir. I will overhook, underhook you, and dance off the fence.'

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is moving up in weight from 155 pounds to 170 pounds to fight Ian Garry.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev while an excellent wrestler... he's a 155er going up to 170.

items.claim: Ian Garry is a natural 170-pound fighter.
Ian Garry came late to learning wrestling compared to Islam Makhachev who has been wrestling since childhood.
items.quote: That Dagestani has been wrestling since he was a little baby. Ian Garry has come late to the wrestling party
